description: Read-only GET of any UOL REST path (spec: https://api.uol.cz/openapi.yaml) for data no other tool covers — e.g. /v1/accounting_records, /v1/bank_movements, /v1/products, /v1/warehouse/statuses, /v1/sales_orders. Returns the raw JSON (amounts as strings, invoice status "valid" = draft); large answers are cut to fit. Prefer the dedicated tools.

path.description: Path under the API root starting with /v1/, e.g. /v1/products

name: api_get
title: Raw UOL GET
